title: Improved Dialogue Render - Part 2
outcome_summary: Transformed the GUI dialogue modal from a flat Markdown rendering pipeline into an interactive, conversation-style view with collapsible tool calls and clean paragraph text, using a new structured data tier (DialogueBlock[]) bridging backend and frontend. The approach adds renderChunksToStructured() to chunk-renderer.ts, a ?format=structured API query parameter, an ES5 API.getChunkStructured() client method, and a buildDialogueHTML() frontend renderer with delegated expand/collapse — all delivered across 7 work packages, 29 pipeline stages, 3399 passing tests, and zero regressions; one Medium XSS finding was fixed forward by the Reviewer before merge.
